newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan approves US$266 mln foreign investments.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan approves US$266 mln foreign investments.

text.p: Taiwan's economics ministry said it approved US$266.43 million worth of foreign investments on the island at a meeting on Friday.
Among them was a US$123.6 million investment by U.S.-based SBC Communications Inc in Taiwan's newly liberalised mobile telephone market, the ministry said in a statement.
SBC has said it planned to sign a T$10 billion mobile phone licence deal with Taiwan's Asia Pacific Investment Co and Goldsun Construction.
The government part-liberalised the telecommunications industry in January, opening up some areas for private and foreign investments.
The ministry also approved US$36 million worth of indirect Taiwanese investment in seven projects in China.
Mitac International Corp got permission to invest US$10 million in a computer project in China.
President Enterprises was allowed to invest US$9.66 million in a new beer company.

The ministry also approved one overseas investment outside China -- a US$25.3 million project by Teco Electric and Machinery Co to build an air-conditioner manufacturing plant in Indonesia. -- Taipei Newsroom (5080815)
